paragraphs.text: Chapter 2 An Enemies Trap
Dante's walk quickly to his father's small house.
Son, you're home!
Dante's father lived alone and he was happy to see his son.
I have good news and bad news father.
Said Dante's.
Captain Leclerc is dead.
He died before we came home.
That is bad news my son.
He was a good man and a good captain.
Said the old man.
But what is the good news?
Father, I feel bad to say it now so soon after Captain Leclerc died.
But I am to become captain of the Pharaoh.
Dante said.
That is great news son.
You will make an excellent captain.
Dante's father said proudly.
Thank you father.
But now please excuse me.
I must go visit someone else.
Ah yes.
Dante's father said.
Have a good visit with your new wife.
Dante's called out to Mercedes as he approached her home.
Mercedes!
Mercedes!
Suddenly a happy voice answered from inside.
I'm here Dante's.
I'm here.
Mercedes answered as she ran to him.
Dante's took her in his arms.
For a few moments the rest of the world disappeared.
The two lovers only knew each other.
But others knew of them.
Sitting and drinking wine nearby was Danglers.
He was busy trying to think of a plan.
He did not want Dante's to be captain.
Just then Mercedes and Dante's walked by the outdoor cafe
where Danglers was drinking.
Talking happily with Mercedes, Dante's didn't see him.
Now that you're captain you won't even talk to your friends.
Danglers asked.
No no.
I was just talking to Mercedes and didn't see you.
Dante's answered.
When is the wedding?
Danglers asked without saying hello.
Soon.
Dante's answered.
Tomorrow or the next day?
You are in a hurry.
Danglers said.
Why are you getting married so quickly Captain?
I'm not captain yet.
Dante's answered.
We are in a hurry because I must go to Paris.
After that with Mr. Morale's blessing I may become captain.
Paris, why must you go to Paris?
Danglers asked.
Before he died, Captain Leclerc asked me to do something for him.
For that reason I'm going to Paris.
Dante's explained.
He said nothing about the letter.
He knew it could be dangerous and he didn't trust Danglers.
You must come to our wedding.
Of course.
Danglers answered.
Then he said quietly to himself.
You will never make it to Paris and you will never be my captain.
Danglers wrote a letter to judge Villefort.
Villefort was the king's judge in Marseilles.
He told the judge he was a friend of the king but he didn't give his name.
In his letter Danglers gave the judge information about Dante's.
He wrote that Dante's was an enemy of the king and that Dante's had a secret letter from Napoleon
for someone in Paris.
He asked the judge to arrest Dante's and question him.
He knew Dante's wouldn't lie to the judge.
He also knew that the secret letter from Napoleon would get Dante's into serious trouble.
Danglers was an evil man.
When he sent the letter he was happy.
He expected to be captain of the Pharaohs soon.
Two days later Dante's and Mercedes had their wedding.
Everyone was there.
Morale, Danglers and other friends and family.
Suddenly as the wedding finished a police officer and four soldiers arrived.
Who is Edmund Dante's?
The officer asked.
I am Edmund Dante's.
Dante's answered.
How can I help you sir?
I am here to arrest you.
The officer answered.
You are to appear before Judge Villefort.
Everyone at the wedding was surprised.
Danglers pretended to be surprised.
But why?
Both Morale and Dante spoke at the same time.
Everything will be explained at the court.
The officer answered.
Please come with me.
Dante's left with the officer and the soldiers.
He gave a last look at Mercedes.
He promised her he would return quickly.
He didn't see the smile on Danglers face.
